visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied in a bun performs on an outdoor stage at night. She is dressed in a white sleeveless collared shirt, a black choker, and a short black pleated skirt. She holds a silver flute to her mouth, playing it while performing rhythmic shoulder and hip movements reminiscent of an Egyptian-style dance. The background features a large yellow banner with world map outlines and stage lighting equipment. (2) The camera cuts to the audience, showing a group of people standing under a blue-lit canopy. Some audience members are holding up smartphones to record, while others sway along to the performance. (3) Back on stage, the woman continues her performance, executing a spin and rapid footwork while maintaining a steady flute melody. (4) A medium close-up shows her lower the flute, smiling brightly at the camera while making a heart gesture with her fingers. (5) She waves to the audience and bows slightly as the scene fades, with a yellow graphic of a drink and bubbles appearing on the right side of the screen.
